pricing_rules_target.name: pricing_rules_target
pricing_rules_target.value: "pricing_rules"."category_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pricing_rules"."vehicle_id" IS NOT NULL

pricing_rules_season.name: pricing_rules_season
pricing_rules_season.value: "pricing_rules"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."valid_from" <= "pricing_rules"."valid_to"

rental_agreements_return_complete.name: rental_agreements_return_complete
rental_agreements_return_complete.value:
("rental_agreements"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("rental_agreements"."return_mileage_km" IS NULL)
        AND ("rental_agreements"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("rental_agreements"."return_fuel_percent" IS NULL)
        AND ("rental_agreements"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("rental_agreements"."return_staff_id" IS NULL)

reservations_money_nonneg.name: reservations_money_nonneg
reservations_money_nonneg.value:
"reservations"."daily_rate_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."base_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."extras_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."one_way_fee_fils" >= 0
        AND "reservations"."subtotal_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."vat_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."total_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."deposit_fils" >= 0
        AND "reservations"."late_fee_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."cancellation_fee_fils" >= 0 AND "reservations"."refunded_fils" >= 0
